structured_data_ordinance.replacement_description_ssot: seo-enrichment.md §3 — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this string. The `replacement_description` field below is a machine-readable COPY of it. If the two ever differ, §3 wins and this field is restamped from §3 — never the reverse, and this field is never edited on its own. Same ordinance as the title SSOT (seo-enrichment.md §1).
structured_data_ordinance.replacement_description: First-page SEO on the key phrases agreed in your contract. Any month we are off target we keep working and your billing pauses until we are back on target.
structured_data_ordinance.replacement_description_rule: Emit verbatim wherever the build writes a `description` in Organization, LocalBusiness, Service or WebSite JSON-LD. A shortening is permitted ONLY if it still contains the pause; a shortening that drops the pause is the defect this ordinance exists to prevent. No exclamation mark, no emoji, no superlative.

replacement_description_corrected.trigger: P7 regression 2 — a machine-read double-source: seo-enrichment.md §3 had been corrected for blocker 6, but this field still carried the superseded string.
replacement_description_corrected.superseded_value: SEO with a first-page guarantee on agreed key phrases — or you don't pay.
replacement_description_corrected.why_wrong: It asserts a TERMINAL non-payment remedy, which D-003 does not contain. D-003 is a monthly retainer agreed up front and assessed month by month: any month we are off target the work CONTINUES and the billing PAUSES, resuming when back on target. The obligation is suspended, not erased. No artifact may state or imply a refund, money-back, risk-free, 'there is no invoice', or any other terminal remedy.
replacement_description_corrected.reach: This field is machine-read by the build and lands in JSON-LD on every page — the highest-reach string in the spec, and the most dangerous place to assert the wrong remedy.
